content_of_post_to_comment: That first mile kills me. Last mile is a pleasure. But I’ve known others who feel the opposite. Just curious why people think they tend to sway one way or the other.
comment: The first mile often feels like a negotiation with your brain. There’s no rhythm yet, your body is still warming up, and every step feels heavier. Once you settle in, the last mile can feel like a reward. I wonder if people who enjoy the start are more motivated by the anticipation, while others get hooked by the momentum.
